review_evidence: Reviewed the complete 1,469-primary-file unit by inventory and source organization. The 1,467 files under TNLean/ cover tensor-network, matrix-product-state, quantum-channel, Perron-Frobenius, spectral, entropy, PEPS and related formal mathematics; 1,347 of those files contain theorem/lemma/example declarations and 512 contain definition/structure/inductive/class/instance declarations.

Generated import aggregators, including TNLean.lean, are retained as navigation surfaces under the campaign policy rather than filtered merely for generated/import-only provenance.

summary: Surveyed all 1562 listed files (all .lean; all present in the checkout): TNLean/MPS 1189, TNLean/PEPS 172, TNLean/Algebra 110, TNLean/QCA 29, TNLean/Wielandt 27, TNLean/Spectral 7, TNLean/Archive 4, TNLean/Tactic 2, TNLean/PiAlgebra 2, TNLeanTest 11, plus root aggregators. A declaration grep found 63 files without theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/notation/macro commands; 60 of these are generated import aggregators (imports plus module docs), which stay primary-eligible under FILTER-007/FD-016 ranking, and the other 3 (QICLeanInterface.lean, Tactic/Attr.lean, Tactic/MatrixReciprocalSmul.lean) carry an import of the companion library, a register_simp_attr command, and an attribute command, so they are outside the pure-import class. Tests, archive counterexamples, and the largest PEPS files hold formal statements and proofs. Disposition: retain all; no exclusions.

summary: Inspected all 33 changed/added Lean files. Every file contains formal mathematical content: definitions (def), theorems (theorem/lemma), structures, and proofs. Examples include multi-block compression data for Fibonacci/CZX/Ising/KramersWannier/Z3Anomalous/MultiBlock examples (MPS/Examples/), gauge covariance of F-matrices (MPDO/CompleteZipperFusionGauge.lean), physical adjoint of MPO tensors (MPDO/PhysicalAdjoint.lean), shift MPU index values at every blocking (MPU/Examples/ShiftBlockedIndex.lean), tensor-product index additivity (MPU/TensorProductIndex.lean), source factors under virtual gauge (MPU/SelectedSourceGateVirtualGauge.lean, MPU/VirtualSourceFactorTransport.lean), simple MPU tensors (MPU/Simple.lean), parity counterexample (MPU/StandardFormParityCounterexample.lean), grouped martingale open-chain gap (ParentHamiltonian/Martingale/GroupedOpenGap.lean), primitive block uniform gap (ParentHamiltonian/Martingale/PrimitiveBlockGap.lean), classical and quantum-double PEPS (PEPS/Examples/Classical.lean, PEPS/Examples/QuantumDouble.lean), and regression tests (TNLeanTest/SpinOperator.lean). The sole import aggregator (Algebra.lean) was already deemed primary-eligible under FD-016. No file meets the hard-exclusion bar of FILTER-004.
